title: Mexico as a personal alternative
seoTitle: Moving to Mexico: residence, family and property | EXOBASIS
description: Prepare a family home or contingency base in Mexico. Connect residence, a Mexico City property, school, healthcare and working payments with practical execution.
intro:
If war, political pressure or the fear of losing control over your money is making you consider leaving, a second home needs to offer more than distance. Your family must be able to enter Mexico, reach the house, continue school or treatment and pay for everyday life.

Mexico City provides a concrete place to work through those decisions. We connect the residence route with the neighbourhood, property, school and care your household needs. EXOBASIS can organise the work from an exploratory visit through a tenancy or purchase to a prepared arrival and the care of your home while you are elsewhere.

sections.title: Choose the life you want Mexico to support
sections.body:
Moving to Mexico works best as a household decision. Your income, children's education, health needs and tolerance for unfamiliar administration shape the place you choose. Someone retiring with a pension has a different starting point from a founder working across countries or a family keeping a second home ready while remaining in the UAE.

For a UK-based household, record each person's passport and immigration position rather than assigning British citizenship to everyone. For a UAE-based household, separate nationality from the residence and sponsorship arrangements you currently rely on. Mexico's entry and residence requirements follow the actual people and proposed stay.

In the Mexico City area, named schools, hospital campuses and an established urban conveyancing process make the preparation concrete. The useful comparison is between homes and ordinary weeks: school runs, appointments, working hours and bills. That is a stronger basis for a decision than a national cost-of-living average or the appeal of a holiday destination. Decide who will handle Spanish-language conversations with the landlord, healthcare and utility providers and appointment offices, using your own language skills or support agreed in advance.

sections.title: Prepare the arrival and preserve the way back
sections.body:
A contingency home needs to be usable before you need it urgently. We plan the journey from your present address through any transit country to the front door in Mexico: the documents for each traveller, a lawful alternative itinerary, onward transport, keys and money available on arrival. If war is driving the preparation, decide early what would trigger the move and who can make that decision if you are unreachable.

Within Mexico City, the final journeys also matter. FCDO describes demonstrations in central areas as well as protests affecting areas popular with visitors. Check the streets you would actually use, access to your accommodation and another way to reach essential services. Its cash-access guidance also identifies ATM robberies and recommends daytime use of machines inside shops or malls.

FCDO: Mexico safety and security.

The return plan has two distinct destinations. A future trip back to Mexico depends on the residence permission you hold, its validity and the stage of any application. Returning to Britain or the UAE depends on the rights you have retained there. The home in Mexico needs its own continuing arrangements for keys, utilities, payments and maintenance while it stands empty.

Use Leaving the UK with a prepared alternative for UK departure obligations and the return position of family members with immigration permission. For Leaving the UAE or preparing a second option, sponsorship, absence, cancellation and final employment payments have their own sequence. Preparing a Mexican home gives you another place to go; the arrangements you choose to keep are maintained separately.

sections.title: Give every family member a workable residence and daily life
sections.body:
Mexico's temporary residence category allows a stay of up to four years in total. Permanent residence is an indefinite category with its own qualifying grounds, including specified retirement and family cases and the route after four years of temporary residence. We match the intended family move to the route supported by your records, then organise the corresponding application work.

Under article 52, a temporary resident's family route includes a spouse, a legally evidenced equivalent partnership, the specified unmarried minor children or children under custody, and a parent. Family membership and the permission obtained are recorded person by person. A permanent resident's spouse or equivalent partner starts with a two-year temporary category under article 55; moving on to permanent residence depends on the relationship continuing.

Mexican Migration Law, articles 52 to 55: residence and family unity.

For a child, the Mexican residence case sits alongside permission to relocate, custody arrangements, access to the passport and the next school's admissions process. UK jurisdictions and UAE family-law arrangements need their own treatment. Our guide Prepare to move abroad with children and family explains those departure questions.

For an older relative, the deciding issue may be who can provide the required daily help or continuing treatment. We put that requirement into the housing brief at the start. An accepted school place, a receiving care provider and the means to pay them give the family a realistic arrival date.

A school place in Humboldt's Lomas Verdes group sets up a different housing search from one at La Herradura or a southern campus; Edron brings its own school journey. Add the actual ABC campus needed for a relative's treatment, whether Observatorio or Santa Fe, before choosing between homes. Demonstrations can affect parts of Mexico City, so the comparison includes local conditions and a usable alternative route for the school run and care visits. A home that works for school but leaves essential treatment out of reach when its usual approach is disrupted is a poor fit for that household. We either adjust the search or arrange a clinically suitable care alternative with the treating team before you commit.

sections.title: Use Mexico between other commitments
sections.body:
You may want to test the country, spend part of the year there or keep a second home ready. Those intentions call for different permissions. The visitor category without paid activities in Mexico allows up to 180 days, with the actual authorised stay governing your visit. Article 53 limits changes from ordinary visitor status, with specific family and humanitarian exceptions. Prepare the intended residence route rather than relying on an assumed conversion after arrival.

Temporary residents have the right to enter and leave during their valid status. Paid work remains connected to the appropriate permission and activity. Where you physically work, how you run a business and where you establish a home also matter for tax; a UK payer or UAE company is not a complete answer to those questions.

Mexican Migration Law, articles 52 and 53.

Before committing to a recurring stay, test the working day at the property: internet, a usable alternative connection, private calls and the hours you need with clients. Then plan the periods when the home is empty. Tenancy conditions, insurance, utility payments and maintenance need to fit the intended pattern. We can organise that preparation as a defined assignment alongside your existing home and advisers.

sections.title: Match the application route to your actual base
sections.body:
Financial means, joining a family member and a work case approved by Mexico's National Migration Institute (INM) lead to different applications. The consular route must fit your legal place of residence and personal circumstances. A British passport and residence in the UAE, for example, are different facts; the passport alone does not choose the office that will accept the case.

Applying through London

The Mexican consular service in London publishes separate temporary-residence routes for financial means, family unity, property and INM-authorised cases. Its financial-means procedure requires a personal appointment, passport, application form and photograph, with evidence of lawful UK residence for non-British applicants. It distinguishes twelve months of qualifying bank or investment records from six months of income evidence and the associated confirmation.

The official MiConsulado guide points to citas.sre.gob.mx and identifies the Consular Section at 16A St George St, London W1S 1FD. We organise the selected category's records and confirm its current financial and appointment requirements for the application. For a UAE-based applicant, the appropriate local filing arrangements are established against that person's legal residence before travel is committed.

Mexican consular service in London: visa routes; London: financial-means application; Official MiConsulado appointment guide.

For London's family procedure, a sponsor outside Mexico accompanies the applicant at the consular appointment. The file connects that person's passport and Mexican visa or residence status with the appropriate marriage, partnership or birth evidence. The visa-holder cases identified in the procedure also require financial support evidence. The intended household and the amount needed for a consular application are different from the cash needed to pay for life after arrival.

London: family-unity application.

Three ways of using Mexico

sections.title: Find a home around the journeys you will actually make
sections.body:
The Mexico City metropolitan area is a location decision within the country. For a school-age family, choose the school and its admissions route alongside the search area. Humboldt's locations include Zona Esmeralda and Lomas Verdes in its northern group, Prado Norte and La Herradura in the west, and Pedregal, Tepepan and La Noria in the south. An English-curriculum household may be considering Edron instead. The school that can meet your child's needs, and the ABC campus or other provider required for care, help determine the housing search.

Addresses across this urban area fall under different jurisdictions. Establish whether the property is in Ciudad de México or Estado de México before appointing the relevant registry and legal work. On an exploratory visit, connect property viewings with school and care appointments, everyday journeys and a check of water, power and building condition. Mexico City's risk atlas supports the location investigation; a building assessment remains work on the actual property.

Demonstrations can also affect central parts of Mexico City. For each prospective home, trace school drop-offs and collections, treatment visits, pharmacy trips and a carer's access, then examine an alternative approach that avoids the affected area and suits the transport required. If the usual access becomes unusable and there is no workable way to keep those essential journeys going, remove that home from the shortlist. This matters especially when school commitments and a relative's regular care have to work on the same day.

Humboldt: locations; Mexico City risk atlas.

Rent first if the location still needs testing

A furnished initial home gives the family somewhere to arrive while you make the longer decision. Before paying, establish the landlord's or agent's authority, permitted use, term, deposit, accepted security and notice arrangements. Separate the rent from utilities, management charges and other recurring costs. Record the condition, defects, inventory and meters at handover. The landlord's acceptance of your particular evidence is part of the transaction preparation.

Buying a private urban property in CDMX

Involve the notary before making the binding contractual commitment. The CDMX notaries' guidance identifies title, the parties' identity and, where relevant, marriage records; five years of property-tax and water records; and condominium documentation with a certificate confirming there are no outstanding management charges. The notary requests the registry certificate, checks authority to sell, encumbrances, use and arrears, and prepares the notarised deed, the escritura. Independent advice for the buyer complements that role.

Completion includes the relevant tax payments and registration of the new owner in the local Registro Público. Acquisition tax, registry charges, certificates, valuation and notarial fees are separate from the price. Predial property tax, water, management and insurance continue after ownership changes. A property in Estado de México receives the applicable local procedure rather than the CDMX process copied across.

Colegio de Notarios CDMX: property purchase and title; CDMX notarial cost components.

Check agrarian history and the restricted zone separately

Where land has an ejido history, establish the completed move into private title: the relevant assembly decision, cancellation at the Registro Agrario Nacional, the issued ownership title and its local public registration. A parcel-rights certificate alone leaves that question unresolved. The statutory rights of first refusal also matter on the first sale after conversion.

The restricted zone extends 100 kilometres along borders and 50 kilometres along beaches. Foreign residential use of a property within that zone calls for the applicable bank-held fideicomiso with SRE permission, including its setup and recurring cost. Acquisition outside that zone follows a different route. A CDMX transaction is not turned into a coastal trust case simply because the buyer is foreign. Residence permission and property rights are prepared as separate parts of your move.

Agrarian Law, articles 80 to 84; Foreign Investment Law: acquisition and restricted zone.

Take the search through to a usable home

EXOBASIS can define the area and housing brief, organise the search and viewings, arrange independent title and purchase checks, and coordinate the agreed contract, completion and handover. You approve the property and financial commitments. Arrange your arrival abroad connects that work with transport, keys, essential services and the first appointments.

sections.title: Secure school and care before fixing the move date
sections.body:
A school place that fits the child's education

Edron describes an expanded UK National Curriculum and age grouping based on the period from 1 September to 31 August. Its admissions sequence runs from initial interest and a visit through application, assessment and enrolment. For a child moving from Britain or a UAE school, compare the actual curriculum, stage, learning support and start date with that process. English as a teaching language is only one part of the match.

Humboldt offers a different educational route. Its application involves an information meeting, paid evaluation and personal diagnostic or observation appointments before enrolment is completed. Kindergarten entry does not require German; later entry conditions depend on campus and year group, with Lomas Verdes describing entry without German up to the fourth primary year. Confirm the specific campus, fees and any transport route before choosing a house around it.

Edron: admissions and curriculum; Humboldt: admissions and language entry.

Our guide Prepare to move abroad with children and family connects school records and relocation permissions with the first ordinary week: who takes the child, who can collect them and what support the family needs.

Arrange the treatment and its payment, not just the policy

For ABC's Observatorio and Santa Fe campuses, admission arrangements include identification, an advance payment and a payment guarantee. Agreed direct billing requires the relevant insurance evidence and authorisation. Doctors' fees are separate from the hospital bill. The receiving department, appointment or treatment needs and means of payment therefore belong in the same preparation.

Emergency care starts with triage. ABC describes reimbursement for outpatient emergency treatment without admission. Where hospitalisation exceeds 24 hours and the insurer has the relevant arrangement, coverage is requested; an advance may still be required. Keep accessible money for that exposure rather than assuming a policy will pay every charge immediately.

ABC: admission requirements; ABC: emergency treatment and payment.

Health cover and care abroad helps you connect the insurer's accepted terms with the provider who will treat you. For continuing therapy or an older relative's daily care, EXOBASIS organises the agreed provider coordination, records, transport and housing requirements. The treating professionals specify the clinical needs; the arrangements bring those needs into the arrival plan. Accessible housing, medication continuity and the person taking over care can decide the location.

Suppose a relative needs regular treatment at ABC Observatorio. Being able to reach Santa Fe would not by itself preserve that treatment plan. A disrupted approach to the required campus could mean a missed session, failed patient transport, delayed medication or no relief for the person providing care. Compare homes on whether another usable route can support those needs; where it cannot, EXOBASIS coordinates the arrangements for an accessible care alternative. The treating team decides clinical suitability and the receiving provider confirms acceptance. If neither access nor an accepted alternative can be arranged, change the housing choice before moving.

sections.title: Keep income, bank access and first payments working
sections.body:
What work will you actually do in Mexico?

A temporary residence based on financial means is distinct from permission for remunerated work. Local employment is connected to the employer offer and applicable INM procedure. Independent work needs the appropriate process, including the described activity and place and, where required, RFC tax registration. We organise the professional assessment around the work you will really carry out.

For Mexican tax residence, article 9 of the Federal Fiscal Code looks at the home you establish. With homes in two countries, the centre of vital interests matters, including the main place of professional activity or more than half of income from Mexican sources. It is not a general 183-day residence test. Mexican residents are generally taxed on worldwide income. For non-residents, employment or independent services physically performed in Mexico can create a Mexican source; the foreign-payer and short-stay exceptions have their own conditions and exclusions.

A UK salary, a UAE company or an account elsewhere must therefore be considered alongside your Mexican home and activity. The departure-country analysis remains separate. We coordinate the required specialist work before those assumptions are built into the household budget.

Migration Law: status and work; Federal Fiscal Code, article 9; Income Tax Law, articles 1, 154 and 156.

For the London financial-means case described above, connect the twelve-month bank or investment record, or six-month income record with its supporting confirmation, to the money you can actually use on arrival. We align the required statements and income evidence with withdrawal restrictions, continuing household costs and the dates rent, school fees and a hospital advance could fall due. That shows whether a separate accessible reserve is needed. A UAE-based case follows its own consulate's evidence requirements; neither consular proof nor a qualifying balance amounts to acceptance by a Mexican bank.

Coordinate a Mexican account with the residence-card process

BBVA's Libretón Básico requirements include adulthood, living in Mexico and a national telephone number. For foreign residents, the published requirements include a passport, valid migration evidence, CURP where needed and address evidence no more than three months old, which may be in another person's name. Confirm with the chosen branch and product which current residence card or document it will accept for your case.

The sequence is practical: prepare the immigration steps, establish the real address, assemble accepted identification, complete the bank's intake and, after acceptance, activate and test the payment functions. A rent deposit, school fee or hospital advance may fall due before the account works. Keep an independently usable, lawful arrival reserve until the Mexican payment route is ready.

BBVA México: Libretón Básico requirements.

For UK-based clients, confirm whether the existing account remains suitable at the new Mexican address. For UAE-based clients, separate final salary or gratuity treatment, residence cancellation, a change of bank product and an actual legal freeze. These can affect different funds and dates. Prepare the source-of-funds records and receiving arrangements before a substantial transfer, then confirm the arrival of a small permitted test payment.

The banking and payments guide explains those distinct problems and the role of an independently usable reserve. Through Prepare banking access and liquidity, you can commission the institution-specific evidence, intake coordination, setup and payment tests. Existing legal restrictions are addressed through their proper process.

Also test recovery when the main phone is unavailable and a representative's own permitted access. The powers of attorney, representation and succession guide connects legal authority with the bank's acceptance and a practical way to act. That matters when someone else must pay the school or keep the business running.

sections.title: Sequence the consulate, INM and the first weeks
sections.body:
1. Prepare the right consular file. Identify the route, legal application location and each person's documents. Procure the required civil records, authentication and translations for that procedure, then align personal attendance with the appointment.
  2. Enter on the intended residence basis. After entry with a residence visa, article 59 requires the application for the residence card at INM within 30 calendar days. This canje is linked to the actual accommodation, address evidence and appointments in Mexico.
  3. Arrange an early departure before travelling. During a timely filed but unfinished procedure, a separate Permiso de salida y regreso may be obtained under the applicable status and procedure conditions. It has a 60-calendar-day period from issue. Apply before departure through the responsible procedure office and obtain the required exit and re-entry stamps. This is a separate permission, not an extension of the 30-day canje application deadline.
  4. Connect the recorded status to daily life. Retain the card and procedure records with the next deadlines. The bank's accepted identification, school entry, treatment and initial bills are coordinated with the stage actually reached.

Migration Law, article 59: residence-card application; INM procedural guidelines, article 36: exit and return.

Our service Arrange residence and document preparation can be commissioned directly. EXOBASIS organises procurement, professional input, appointments and follow-up, and hands over a clear account of submissions, decisions and the remaining steps. Personal documents are handled through the agreed protected channel.

sections.title: Keep the permission and the home usable while life changes
sections.body:
Article 63 requires residents to report changes in marital status, nationality, address and workplace within 90 days. This reporting duty is separate from the initial residence-card application, card renewal and the bank's customer-record updates. A changed address may require several connected actions.

Migration Law, article 63: reporting changes.

The property has its own continuing work: rent or Predial property tax, water, management, insurance, inspections and repairs. A relevant fideicomiso adds its contractual dates and charges. Before you return, keys, services and the agreed arrival arrangements are checked. Spending authority is set in advance so that someone can deal with the defined tasks while you are away.

Maintain the arrangements in the country you keep as well. For a UAE household, permit expiry, an absence condition and cancellation are different events. For a family member returning to the UK on immigration permission, the actual status and usable travel records matter. A new phone, passport or representative also needs to reach the relevant records and access procedures.

Review and maintain your preparations provides a defined continuing assignment: agreed checks, necessary follow-up and a clear report of what has been done or needs your decision. Larger new procedures, repairs and additional professional work are agreed separately. The purpose is a home and set of arrangements that remain usable, not a folder left untouched after the move.

sections.title: Commission the Mexico preparation you need
sections.body:
You can ask EXOBASIS to coordinate the family move or take on a defined part of it. That may be choosing the area, organising an exploratory visit, finding a tenancy, preparing a purchase or connecting school and healthcare to an already selected home. Property work can include independent title and purchase checks, contract and completion coordination, handover and subsequent care.

We agree the result, responsibilities and costs before the work begins. Search and coordination, local professional services and your own payments for property, travel, authorities and providers are distinct items. Exobasis LLC is the operator and contracting company. A known task can be commissioned directly; an orientation call or personal initial assessment is a separate way to start when you first need to decide the direction.

Compare Mexico with Costa Rica and Panama

Costa Rica as a personal alternative gives you a useful comparison if a pension or other stable income is central to the family plan. Its Pensionado and Rentista routes are distinct from the time-limited digital-nomad estancia. Compare those conditions with the Mexican residence case and with the actual school, treatment and housing arrangements each location could support.

Panama as a personal alternative raises a different comparison: a home for the family, an international-services location and a contingency destination may serve different purposes. Its transit role and local travel dependencies belong beside any banking or business attraction. Compare the household's location and arrival route with your Mexico plan rather than letting the address of a service provider choose where the family lives.

Choose suitable countries and locations takes these alternatives into a personal comparison. If Mexico is already the decision, bring us the work that now needs doing.

For the first contact, a broad Mexico-related task and a reply route are enough. The enquiry category and optional public page context can be changed. Passports, detailed finances and access credentials belong in the later protected exchange, not in the public enquiry.

faq.question: Can I use the requirements of any Mexican consulate?
faq.answer: Use the procedure that accepts your actual legal residence, intended stay and personal category. London publishes its own routes and evidence requirements; a British passport alone does not settle the application location for someone living in the UAE. We organise the applicable file and appointment rather than transferring financial figures from another consulate.
